[Nightmare Files] Stoned

A downloadable game for Windows

Download NowName your own price

This free demo offers an exclusive look at the prologue of the story. Dive into the opening chapter, where you'll explore the atmosphere, mechanics, and core features that set the stage for the full game.

The demo serves as an introduction to the story, revealing how you came to the island and offering a glimpse of what awaits. The full game takes you deeper into the island and its labyrinths as you search for a way out.

If you like this demo, make sure you wishlist the full game!

CHOREOGRAPHED EVENTS


Experience the world of Nightmare Files, where the story unfolds around you in real-time through scripted events.

PHYSICAL INTERACTIONS

Interact with the world naturally, pulling, pushing, and grabbing. Every action feels tactile, opening the door to immersive and quirky gameplay moments.

IMMERSIVE ENVIRONMENTS

Lose yourself in a meticulously crafted environment. PSX-ish style visuals, rich soundscapes and sound effects bring every moment to life. Hear sounds change as you move, get muffled behind walls, or echo in certain spaces.

CLICK HERE to WISHLIST on Steam to get updates and be the first to experience the haunting mystery when it releases

Midnight Matinee Games1 day ago(+1)

Enjoy this no-commentary playthrough! If you liked the video, please be sure to wishlist the game on Steam and support the creator.

Really enjoyed this demo. The game has a great isolated horror setup mixed with a good blend of adventure and storytelling. You hit the right tone with the absurd opening in the city, followed by the dark humor on the ship, then into a mysterious island atmosphere where you feel like something is stalking you.

The short puzzle mechanics are engaging and the retro aesthetic looks fantastic. I didn't run into any bugs or technical issues during my playthrough. There is way more depth to this than I initially expected. I'm really looking forward to the full game!

This game is awesome, but...

On the island, if you step on the flare gun, it will play the falling/stepping sound over and over again. I also don’t like how the dialogue looks, having to click on “Continue” instead of pressing E, the crosshair following the characters while I have a second cursor on my screen. And for some reason, I don’t like how the characters look. It’s just, IDK, not quite right for me. It is also quite chaotic using the tools, like once you have to double-click and then you have to pull it to the top "hand bar".

But...

I love how the fire looks, I love the ending and the whole Island chapter. I love that BANANA Monster and that RICKROLL :) And that vault opening is so COOL. I hope this game will be PEAK.
